render_tensor_template: run the render_tensor_template CLI to render a Jinja template for custom tensor class type stubs
render_tensor_template_with_vars: run the render_tensor_template CLI with template substitutions like foo=1,bar=2 to generate output
render_tensor_template_strip_lint: run the render_tensor_template CLI to render a Jinja template while stripping # LINT lines
render_tensor_template_with_reduction_ax: run the render_tensor_template CLI to render a template with reduction_axes available as a global
render_tensor_template_output_file: run the render_tensor_template CLI to write rendered output to a specified output file
